verses.text: By the sky and the pulsar.
But what can make you sg realize what the pulsar is?
There is no self but has [1] a preserver over it.
Let man look at what he was created from.
He was created from an ejected fluid,
coming out from between the backbone and the breastbones.
He is certainly able to return him
on the day when the secrets are put on trial,
then he will have neither strength nor helper.
By the earth that cracks open—
it is most surely a decisive word[3],
So give sg the deniers respite; respite them briefly.

footnotes.1: Qira’at: All except for Ibn ‘Amer, Asem, Hamza and Abu Ja’far read it as: “Every self has a preserver over it.”
footnotes.2: According to Al-Qurtubi, the majority of exegetes mentioned that it is the rain which returns the water in the form of recurring rain.
